# GMRI Setup Desk — directions

Open https://gmri-setup-desk.robert-hanso-5875.chatgpt.site in your browser while signed into the account that owns it.

## What is ready

Five rebuilt workflow packages: Cloud Access 0.3.0; Compute Fabric, Spatial Systems, Research & Evidence, and Engineering Operations 0.2.0. The original identities, starter prompts and domain policies are preserved. The four invalid schema keys are corrected. Each plugin includes onboarding instructions and distinguishes configured connections from verified connections.

This companion setup screen prepares downloadable packages; installing a plugin does not automatically embed or open this screen. The screen does not host Proxmox/NetBird MCP servers, authenticate with upstream APIs, or modify your installed ChatGPT plugins. It has no remote arbitrary-code runner and does not require a desktop client.

## First connection: Porkbun

1. Choose Cloud Access, then Porkbun. The MCP address is prefilled from your supplied package: "'`https://mcp.porkbun.com/mcp/no-purchases`.
2. Choose Open ChatGPT Plugins. From your GMRI plugin details page use Add app, or use the custom MCP creation flow offered by ChatGPT.
3. Choose Server URL and paste that address. Let ChatGPT discover the authentication requirements. Complete provider sign-in when offered. Do not enter a Porkbun API key into a field intended for an OAuth client secret.
4. If initialization fails, retain the exact error. URL reachability, MCP protocol support and provider authorization are separate checks. This release has not verified Porkbun'"'s live endpoint.
5. Copy the created connection's full ChatGPT plugin details URL. Return to this desk and paste it into Registered app link or ID. The accepted ID families are "'`plugin_asdk_app_` and `plugin_connector_`, followed by 32 hexadecimal characters. An unfamiliar legitimate family should be reviewed and added, not manually rewritten.
6. Choose Check configuration. This checks syntax only; it does not validate account ownership or credentials.
7. Repeat for any other service you need, then Download configured plugin. Only services with an entered valid app ID are attached. Each included app is an explicit dependency; unselected services remain unattached.
8. Give the resulting ZIP to Plugin Creator and ask it to update the existing GMRI plugin, preserving audience and identity. Do not create a replacement plugin merely because discovery is incomplete.
9. Cloud migration: bind and verify the replacement Porkbun connection before retiring a previously working one. Plugin Creator must inspect the existing inventory and pass `delete_paths: ["mcp.json"]` when removing that legacy file. Overlay upload alone leaves omitted files intact. The generated ZIP intentionally contains no mcp.json.
10. Start a new conversation. Use the service-specific verification prompt from the desk. A real successful read-only tool call, timestamp and receipt establish VERIFIED. Do not infer this from a selected plugin or accepted ZIP.

## Which value goes where?

| Field | Meaning | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| MCP server URL | Deployed MCP endpoint, usually HTTPS with /mcp | Helps you register the service in ChatGPT; not inserted as a bundled MCP declaration |
| Upstream API base URL | Address used by your MCP gateway to reach Proxmox, NetBird or another service | An optional profile note; does not create an adapter or connectivity |
| Registered app link or ID | ChatGPT'"'s identifier for the actual service connection | Included in .app.json in the generated plugin |
| API key/token | Provider or gateway credential | Optional encrypted-backup entry only; never inserted into a plugin ZIP or used for a connection test |
| Backup passphrase | Protects your saved setup backup | Encrypts/decrypts locally; cannot be recovered by this desk |

## Proxmox and NetBird

These services need their own deployed MCP integrations. The original package named ProxmoxMCP-Plus, sergelogvinov/proxmox-mcp and netbirdio/netbird-mcp but did not provide their deployment addresses or credentials.

- Proxmox operator: attach the deployed ProxmoxMCP-Plus integration.
- Proxmox observer: attach a separately deployed, read-only observer where available. Two names pointing to the same service do not establish independent verification.
- NetBird: attach its deployed MCP integration. Its management API base URL alone is insufficient.
- For private services, use a supported Secure MCP Tunnel or an already authorized reachable gateway. A tunnel client can run on the server that can reach the service; this setup desk does not install it. Do not open public ports or weaken policies to bypass a reachability problem.
- Configure upstream tokens in the gateway's supported secret store. Follow that deployment's documentation for exact token/header formats; the desk does not guess them.

## Other four plugins

Choose only the apps needed for your immediate task. Existing connected provider apps can be attached using their real ChatGPT IDs. Host-provided skills and native tools are not apps and should not receive invented IDs. A plugin listing a provider in its workflow does not install or authorize that provider.

Compute Fabric: Convex, YepCode, qBraid as needed. Spatial Systems: GIS Cloud, BigGeo AI as needed. Research & Evidence: search, scholarly, Drive and technical-documentation providers as needed. Engineering Operations: GitHub and technical-documentation providers as needed. Specialized skills already present remain usable; desktop execution is required only for a task that actually depends on local hardware or build tools.

## Save and restore

The desk keeps entered values only in this tab's memory. It does not use localStorage, cookies or a server database to retain those values. Closing or reloading loses unsaved inputs.

To save: enter a passphrase of at least 14 characters and download the encrypted backup. It uses AES-256-GCM with a random salt and IV, and PBKDF2-SHA256 with 600,000 iterations. Keep the passphrase separately. To restore: enter the passphrase, choose Restore backup, and select the encrypted JSON file. A wrong passphrase or modified file is rejected. Use Clear this session to remove entries from the form and in-memory profile; JavaScript cannot promise forensic memory erasure.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Next action |
|---|---|
| No tunnels yet | No usable tunnel is registered here. Configure one on a reachable server or use an existing HTTPS MCP endpoint. |
| Invalid app ID | Paste the full details URL of the registered service app, not the GMRI workflow package URL. |
| OAuth/initialization failure | Keep the exact error and inspect the service's advertised auth/protocol configuration. Do not substitute arbitrary keys. |
| Missing tools in a chat | Confirm the app is connected, the configured plugin update was installed, and test in a new conversation. |
| Desktop-only label remains | Capture the exact label/location and inspect the current installed release and workspace eligibility. This rebuild does not establish the platform classifier's cause. |
| Configured ZIP accepted but service fails | Installation and authorization are separate. Run the read-only test and report the actual failure stage. |
